p1_findings.title: GET /api/search — Route Not Wired in app.ts
p1_findings.description: The search route has a full 5-test suite and Verifies comments but is never registered in app.ts. Tests are silently failing in CI without surfacing as build-breaking.
p1_findings.fix: Implement GET /api/search?q= handler (filter work item store, return {data:[...]}) and register in app.ts. Alternatively add test.skip with tracking comment.

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Blind to 100 of 113 Requirements
p1_findings.description: The enforcer only checks the most-recently-modified Plans/*/requirements.md (13 requirements). Specifications/ (74+10 FRs) and older plans are never verified. Gate reports PASS while 88% of requirements are unchecked.
p1_findings.fix: Extend get_active_requirements() to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md files. Add --specs flag for Specifications/*.md scanning.

p1_findings.title: protobufjs Code Injection + DoS (co-vulnerability with DEP-001)
p1_findings.fix: Covered by DEP-001 fix: npm update protobufjs@>=7.5.5
p1_findings.note: No additional effort — resolved by DEP-001 patch

p2_findings.title: Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md — 74 FRs with 0% Implementation
p2_findings.description: 74 requirements (FR-001 to FR-074) with zero implementation. Either obsolete (archive it) or represents massive unrealized scope (needs a tracking plan).
p2_findings.fix: Add Status: ARCHIVED header to the file, OR create Plans/dev-workflow-platform/ with implementation status tracking.

p2_findings.title: Plans/dependency-linking References Stale portal/ Path Structure
